name: Fushimi Yuuki
source:
Fushimi is Takaaki's best friend. He is a very polite and considerate person, that a lot of people take to be very serious. He is somewhat naive in what is going on around him, so most topics of conversation are things new to him. He enjoys many "feminine" hobbies such as housekeeping and interior design, and dislikes being picked on about it.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/xasy/xasy.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
